core_obligations: Lemma finite-unramified-one-point gives a neighbourhood U over which pi restricts to a closed immersion.
A morphism that is etale and a closed immersion is an open immersion (Theorem etale-radicial-open); after shrinking, pi is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Apply the finite unramified one-point lemma for the closed immersion; upgrade to open immersion by the radicial-open theorem; shrink to an isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: Two-step: closed immersion from the unramified one-point lemma, open immersion from etale + closed via the radicial-open theorem.
